tasks.spec: ## Repository: console, Behavior: pure modules for Second-factor policy, TOTP, Seed encryption and Recovery codes. Acceptance 1 policy cases, 4, 5 matchRecoveryCode unit cases, 8 envelope cases and 9 pure key rules; corresponding Counterexamples. Complete the coupled auth flows together, reusing #562's setup/password/throttle foundations. Register the six new route access/phase/method rules; T4 supplies account security, regeneration and session management. tasks.title: Account management keeps this browser signed in while ending other sessions
tasks.spec: ## Repository: console, Behavior: Account security page and landing link, New recovery codes, Sessions/sign out all, remaining HTTP rules/metrics/logs/docs; Acceptance 5 regeneration, 6, final 10 leak scan, 11 and 13; every Checks and Completion evidence item, Performance impact evidence and Security impact checklist. New recovery codes require password recheck and replace the set atomically; try old codes in fresh-server batches 4/4/2 without 429. Sign out all uses T2 deleteOtherSessions for every other stage, cascades their pending authenticators and retains the current row/cookie/CSRF without Set-Cookie; plain Sign out ends only the current session. Document the later password-change rule, which must call deleteOtherSessions inside its hash-update transaction, without adding that endpoint. Add Docker malformed-key check and deploy-dev using the approved checkout pin, persist-credentials false, contents read, no repository secrets and E2E_CONSOLE_FLOW=two-factor against deploy main after deploy merges. Preserve the existing root/header Docker check and release dependencies. A deploy-side two-factor defect means needs-input and a shared finding with the failed step/spec citation, never a cross-repository edit or weakened CI. Finish responsive/no-JS checks, documentation and public evidence with no live secrets.
